title: publish_progress item (PublishProgressUnit)
description: Completeness of a publish per unit (publishId, sourceVersion, shard) (RF-084, RF-022). DISENO S3 (c).
$comment: Table publish_progress (per cell). PK = PUB#<publishId>, SK = UNIT#<sourceVersion>#S<shard>. AP-I7: Query PK. TTL attribute ttl = TTL_job. Feeds PublishProjectionCompleted.v1 (EV-23). Unit state IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED (DISENO 3.8.2).

sourceVersion.description: Eligible source version label of the unit.

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter TTL_job (no value fixed in the docs).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED when the unit is materialised (unit worker of ms-engagement-index). Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
